title: external.compliance.disclosed payload (v1)
description: Compliance disclosure event emitted by ingestion for category COMPLIANCE_DISCLOSURE (webhook or connector item). Pointers/excerpts only; raw body stays in object storage. Producer: ingestion. Exchange: aegispulse.ingress. FRs: FR-WHK-04, FR-WHK-05, FR-CON-03. Describes only the envelope `payload` (PROJECT.md §6.4, §6.7); consumers ignore unknown fields (NFR-13).
